_note: Blended USD per million tokens (input + cache + output summed) per model family, fitted to recorded runs.jsonl lines holding usage and a real cost_usd. cost_estimate.py selftest checks it stays within 35 percent per model. usage_input is USD per million input tokens fitted to the host totals in docs/reports/2026-10-07-subagent-mode-live/host-cost.txt (T-0328); usage_multipliers scale it for output, cache read and cache write tokens. usage_calibration (T-0332) multiplies the transcript input and output counts (last line per message id): the host reports input about 200 to 250 times and output about 1.25 times the transcript's (R1 verifier input 260 vs 51956, output 14852 vs 18417; final-rerun verifier input 486 vs 120787, output 20945 vs 27041), while the cache fields match exactly; fitted on those two rows plus the L2 opus verifier, estimate/host 0.83 to 0.93. haiku is refit for Claude Haiku 5.5 (T-0359) on the one recorded scout run (docs/reports/2026-10-07-haiku-5-5/runs.jsonl, resolved model claude-haiku-5-5, host cost 0.00559222): list price is $0.10 input and $0.50 output per MTok for prompts up to 100K tokens ($0.50 and $2.50 above), cache read $0.01, cache write $0.125 (5m) or $0.20 (1h), and the newer tokenizer counts about 30 percent more tokens than Haiku 4.5; usage_input haiku 0.095 reproduces that host cost (estimate 0.00559 vs the earlier 0.034094) and sits at the lower-tier list rate, the per-request prompts staying under 100K; the blended haiku rate is scaled from it (0.034), not fitted; one row only, so the selftest pins it with a fixture rather than a recorded-history band.
